-- PAS = |patsim - peercorr| < 0.1 AND peercorr > 0.7
SELECT ab.abhvreg, ab.patsim, ab.peercorr, ABS(ab.patsim - ab.peercorr) as pas
FROM advancedbehavior ab
WHERE ABS(ab.patsim - ab.peercorr) < 0.1 AND ab.peercorr > 0.7
LIMIT 10;

-- Check Collusion Network Indicator conditions
SELECT invdetreg, tcirclesz, grpbehsc, commpat
FROM investigationdetails
WHERE tcirclesz > 5 AND grpbehsc > 0.6 AND commpat = 'Regular'
LIMIT 10;

-- Build the full query: Find compliance cases with network mimic risk traders
-- Step 1: Check the join path
SELECT cc.compreg, cc.transref, t.tradereg, ab.abhvreg, ab.patsim, ab.peercorr, 
       inv.invdetreg, inv.tcirclesz, inv.grpbehsc, inv.commpat
FROM compliancecase cc
JOIN transactionrecord tr ON cc.transref = tr.transreg
JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg
LEFT JOIN advancedbehavior ab ON tr.transreg = ab.translink
LEFT JOIN investigationdetails inv ON cc.compreg = inv.compref
WHERE ABS(ab.patsim - ab.peercorr) < 0.1 
  AND ab.peercorr > 0.7
  AND inv.tcirclesz > 5 
  AND inv.grpbehsc > 0.6 
  AND inv.commpat = 'Regular'
LIMIT 10;

-- Full query with Investigation Intensity Index calculation
SELECT cc.compreg, cc.transref, t.tradereg, ab.abhvreg, 
       ROUND(CAST((0.6 * inv.behansc + 0.4 * inv.netansc) AS numeric), 2) as investigation_index,
       inv.behansc, inv.netansc,
       cc.risksc, cc.fposrate, cc.modelconf
FROM compliancecase cc
JOIN transactionrecord tr ON cc.transref = tr.transreg
JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg
JOIN advancedbehavior ab ON tr.transreg = ab.translink
JOIN investigationdetails inv ON cc.compreg = inv.compref
WHERE ABS(ab.patsim - ab.peercorr) < 0.1 
  AND ab.peercorr > 0.7
  AND inv.tcirclesz > 5 
  AND inv.grpbehsc > 0.6 
  AND inv.commpat = 'Regular'
ORDER BY investigation_index DESC;
